# Get timestamp for version string
TIMESTAMP="${{ steps.COMMIT_TIMESTAMP.outputs.COMMIT_TIMESTAMP }}"

# For PRs and non-main pushes, use current version
if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ] || [ "${{ github.ref }}" != "refs/heads/main" ]; then
  CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json)
  echo "APP_VERSION=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "APP_FULL_VERSION=$CURRENT_VERSION-${{ inputs.distribution-channel || 'main' }}.${TIMESTAMP}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  echo "SHOULD_RELEASE=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
else
  # For main branch, check semantic-release
  LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  
  # Run semantic-release and capture both stdout and stderr
  OUTPUT=$(npx semantic-release --dry-run --no-ci 2>&1 || true)
  
  # Check if semantic-release actually ran (not "not found")
  if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "semantic-release: not found"; then
    SEMANTIC_RELEASE_FAILED=true
  else
    SEMANTIC_RELEASE_FAILED=false
  fi
  
  # Check if there will be a release (look for common success indicators)
  if [ "$SEMANTIC_RELEASE_FAILED" = "false" ] && echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "(next release version|published release|creating tag|analysis of .* commits complete)"; then
    # Try multiple extraction patterns (semantic-release output varies by version)
    NEW_VERSION=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP "(?:The next release version is|Published release|Creating tag) \K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | head -1)
    
    # If direct extraction fails, try alternative patterns
    if [ -z "$NEW_VERSION" ]; then
      NEW_VERSION=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP "version \K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | head -1)
    fi
    
    # If still no version, try JSON output pattern
    if [ -z "$NEW_VERSION" ]; then
      NEW_VERSION=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -oP '"nextRelease".*?"version":\s*"\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1)
    fi
    
    if [ -n "$NEW_VERSION" ]; then
      echo "APP_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      echo "APP_FULL_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      echo "SHOULD_RELEASE=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    fi
  fi
  
  # If we still don't have a version or semantic-release failed, use manual detection
  if [ -z "$NEW_VERSION" ] || [ "$SEMANTIC_RELEASE_FAILED" = "true" ]; then
    CURRENT_VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json)
    
    # Get commits since last tag
    LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "")
    if [ -z "$LAST_TAG" ]; then
      COMMITS=$(git log --pretty=format:"%s" HEAD)
    else
      COMMITS=$(git log --pretty=format:"%s" ${LAST_TAG}..HEAD)
    fi
    
    # Count releasable commit types (with or without scope) using robust awk-based counting
    # awk ensures numeric output (defaults to 0) even if grep returns empty or unexpected values
    FIX_COUNT=$(echo "$COMMITS" | awk '/^fix(\([^)]*\))?:/ {count++} END {print count+0}')
    FEAT_COUNT=$(echo "$COMMITS" | awk '/^feat(\([^)]*\))?:/ {count++} END {print count+0}')
    PERF_COUNT=$(echo "$COMMITS" | awk '/^perf(\([^)]*\))?:/ {count++} END {print count+0}')
    REFACTOR_COUNT=$(echo "$COMMITS" | awk '/^refactor(\([^)]*\))?:/ {count++} END {print count+0}')
    BUILD_COUNT=$(echo "$COMMITS" | awk '/^build(\([^)]*\))?:/ {count++} END {print count+0}')
    
    # Check if we have any releasable commits (awk ensures all values are numeric)
    TOTAL_RELEASABLE=$(awk "BEGIN {print $FIX_COUNT + $FEAT_COUNT + $PERF_COUNT + $REFACTOR_COUNT + $BUILD_COUNT}")
    
    if [ "$TOTAL_RELEASABLE" -gt 0 ]; then
      # Calculate next version
      if [ "$FEAT_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
        # Minor bump for feat
        NEXT_VERSION=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | awk -F. '{$2=$2+1; $3=0; print $1"."$2"."$3}')
      else
        # Patch bump for fix/perf/refactor/build
        NEXT_VERSION=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | awk -F. '{$3=$3+1; print $1"."$2"."$3}')
      fi
      
      echo "APP_VERSION=$NEXT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      echo "APP_FULL_VERSION=$NEXT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# Unset GitHub Actions env vars that interfere with semantic-release
unset GITHUB_REF
unset GITHUB_REF_NAME
unset GITHUB_HEAD_REF
unset GITHUB_BASE_REF

export GITHUB_REF="refs/heads/${PR_HEAD_REF}"
export GITHUB_REF_NAME="${PR_HEAD_REF}"

OUTPUT=$(npx --package semantic-release@${{ env.SEMANTIC_RELEASE_VERSION }} \
  --package @semantic-release/changelog@6.0.0 \
  --package @semantic-release/git@10.0.0 \
  --package conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits@8.0.0 \
  semantic-release \
  --dry-run \
  --no-ci \
  --branches "${PR_HEAD_REF}" 2>&1 || true)

NEW_VERSION=$(echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -Eio "the next release version is [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | grep -Eo "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" || echo "")

if [ -z "$NEW_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Could not determine next version. Ensure the PR has conventional commits (feat:, fix:, etc.)"
  exit 1
fi

echo "version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
